summary: Frontend-only verification of two new features: StatsPanel on /dashboard and MonthlyCalendar (Kalender Bulanan) tabs on both /dashboard and public /jadwal. All features work as specified. No console errors or crashes while switching between all three tabs on both pages.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor UX inconsistency: StatsPanel counts ALL schedules (past + future, total=4) while the table shows 3 (filters past dates via isPastDate). Label 'seluruh jadwal tercatat' is accurate but users may expect active-only totals. Consider aligning or clarifying the label.

MonthlyCalendar uses `schedules` (all, incl. past) on Dashboard while WeeklyCalendar uses `activeSchedules`. Mixed semantics are OK but worth documenting; past meetings will persist visually in the month grid.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seeded schedules (3 shown in table, 4 total).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public page /jadwal has data-testids: public-tab-tabel, public-tab-kalender, public-tab-bulanan. Dashboard tabs: tab-tabel, tab-kalender, tab-bulanan. Stats panel testids: stats-panel, stats-total, stats-room-<RoomName>, stats-hour-<Hour>. MonthlyCalendar: monthly-calendar, month-prev, month-next, month-today. Login inputs have no name/type attrs — select by order or placeholder (Masukkan username / Masukkan password). Server date observed as 2026-10-11; seeded schedules on 2026-10-12/13.
